headline: Five of five preregistered HOLDOUT confirmation gates supported.
confirmed_mechanisms: Five-minute mean reversion is broad and robust across time, move magnitude, probability region, relative spread and transparent state.
Depth-normalised BBO OFI carries small but stable incremental information beyond a frozen simple baseline; its naive sign is often contrarian.
PRICE_DISCOVERY is a short repricing/transition state, not a generic momentum regime.
LIQUIDITY_STRESS is metastable and has a meaningful transition path into REPLENISHMENT.
Visible replenishment after withdrawal is associated with substantially lower subsequent absolute price movement.
important_negatives: Microprice did not add meaningful incremental directional value.
Raw event OFI, generic visible multi-level flow, generic LOB shape, generic common-liquidity direction and generic age direction did not earn promotion.
HMM and Hawkes complexity was not justified.
No claim is made that the confirmed mechanisms are executable after fees, queue position, latency and fill selection.
execution_boundary: Route survivors to replay/live diagnostics first. Do not wire directly into MAKE from this experiment.
